description: This Java class implements a command strategy for adjusting a loan charge within the Fineract batch processing framework. It processes batch requests, extracts relevant URL parameters, calls the LoanChargesApiResource to perform the adjustment, and constructs the BatchResponse accordingly.

classes.name: AdjustChargeCommandStrategy
classes.description: Implements the CommandStrategy to handle batch requests for adjusting loan charges by invoking the LoanChargesApiResource and managing response formatting.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the batch request to adjust a loan charge by parsing request URL, calling the API resource, and preparing the batch response.
